abstract: We report a case of an extragonadal germ cell tumor from the retrovesical region associated with Klinefelter's syndrome. The patient presented with symptoms of macroscopic hematuria and micturition pain. An x-ray and digital examination were suspicious for prostatic carcinoma. However, needle biopsy of the tumor revealed embryonal cell carcinoma. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was 10,700 ng. per ml. Preoperatively, combined cytotoxic chemotherapy was administered and the antineoplastic effect was excellent. Serum alpha-fetoprotein rapidly returned to the normal range and the tumor volume decreased. Although the preoperative diagnosis was extragonadal germ cell tumor of the prostate, surgery revealed that the tumor originated from the retrovesical region. Orchiectomy and resection were performed. The resected tissue was mostly necrotic with a few viable cells of embryonal cell carcinoma, no metastatic lesions were detected in the lymph nodes and no masses were noted in the testes. Postoperatively, the patient was treated with cytotoxic chemotherapy. His condition has remained good with no clinical evidence of recurrence of the disease.
abstract_ja: 我々はクラインフェルター症候群に伴う膀胱後部の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告する。患者は肉眼的血尿と排尿時痛を呈した。X線検査と直腸診で前立腺癌が疑われた。しかし腫瘍の針生検で胎児性癌と診断された。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は10,700 ng/mlであった。術前に併用細胞毒性化学療法を行い、抗腫瘍効果は良好であった。血清AFPは速やかに正常範囲へ戻り、腫瘍容積は縮小した。術前診断は前立腺の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍であったが、手術で腫瘍は膀胱後部由来であることが判明した。精巣摘除術および切除を施行した。切除組織は大部分が壊死で、胎児性癌の生存細胞がわずかに認められた。リンパ節転移は検出されず、精巣に腫瘤は認められなかった。術後も細胞毒性化学療法を施行した。経過は良好で、臨床的に再発の所見はない。
